programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: The Boys play City Slickers spending time at WineGlass ranch nestled in the foothills near Cochrane, Alberta where evidence of First Nations settlements and buffalo jumps date back 11,000 years and tales of the real Sundance Kid still exist.

programs.title: Deadly Science
programs.desc: Innovators throughout history have pushed human ingenuity to the edge; Lilienthal pioneered flight, Abakovsky's high-speed train derailed tragically, and Bullock's printing press revolutionized publishing, yet these advancements came at a high cost.

programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: A diplomat with a critical heart condition dies and is transported to another planet; a woman suffers a fatal miscarriage and finds herself meeting familiar spirits in the afterlife, only to come back to her physical body.

programs.title: Mapping Disaster
programs.desc: A team of experts breaks down significant disasters in history, including the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, the Suez Canal blockage, the California wildfires of 2020, the 1970 Yungay, Peru, avalanche, and the bombings of Hiroshima.

programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: Jordyn and Johnny investigate a turn of the century house turned restaurant. Billed as the most haunted place in the province, they experience the presence of several ghosts that have them chasing them up and down the stairs.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: Wildfires ravage Canada's North, throwing a wrench into the crew's northern expedition plans. With a lack of planes, helicopters, and supplies the group must find ways to overcome these issues. Meanwhile, Johann makes a trip to pick up special equipment as Mack and David uncover the history of which Explorer's Club Flag they will bring on their final expedition.

programs.title: Alien Corridors
programs.desc: Nearly 3.7 million people claim to have experienced something not of this Earth; most are dismissed, ignored or silenced, but they cannot all be wrong.

programs.title: Secret Societies: In the Shadows
programs.desc: At the height of their power, the Knights Templar owned vast swathes of land, commanded fleets, and lent money to Kings; their powers expanded across Europe and left enduring mythologies in their wake.

programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: Cameras capture an entire city floating in the sky; a signal comes from under a tiny island off the coast of Africa; a powerful radio beam from deep space reaches Earth only to vanish and never return.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: In 1950, physicist Enrico Fermi famously asked, "Where is everybody?"; in such a vast universe, how could life exist only on Earth? This existential query has fueled decades of debate, conjuring visions of alien worlds.

programs.title: Engineering Evolved
programs.desc: All aboard an exciting high-speed journey through time witnessing the birth and evolution of one of the most important forms of transportation ever invented, the train.
